{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''Blu''' was a group of three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]]. Two of the freighters were carrying [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], while the third one was carrying [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]]. The one with the warheads was destroyed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their [[Mission to Almaran|recon mission]] of the Imperial fleet.
